clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Field of Giants, silithid eggs lie buried beneath the soil. Horde researchers gather them to learn about the swarm spreading through the southern Barrens.

Silithid mounds rise from the Field of Giants as strange insect-like creatures churn the earth. Their eggs lie beneath the hardened soil, guarded by territorial silithid. The Horde knows little about these creatures, but scouts at the Crossroads have seen signs of coordination and intelligence beyond that of ordinary wild beasts. Unhatched eggs may help scholars in Orgrimmar learn about the silithid’s life cycle and nature.

Silithid eggs must be dug from the mounds with an adapted digging claw. The creatures defend their underground nurseries fiercely, swarming anyone who threatens their unhatched young. Korran, a troll researcher, needs intact specimens for study before the swarm spreads farther across Kalimdor.
